method.images: Decoded displayed PNG RGB channel codes; input range 0..255. Unweighted whole image; excludes alpha.
method.rgb_mae: Mean absolute difference across all RGB channels, code levels.
method.pixel_tail: p95/p99/max of per-pixel maximum absolute RGB channel difference in code levels; gt8_pct fraction of pixels where any channel differs by >8, reported in percent.
method.temporal: Within a continuous named sequence only. D_t - D_(t-1) minus A_t - A_(t-1), signed RGB differences in code levels, followed by absolute statistics; range 0..510. Also report each variant's adjacent-frame RGB MAE. The residual includes genuine evolution, moving edges and motion. No motion compensation.
method.worst: Rank by full-frame RGB MAE, tie broken by name.
